            <lb n="67a6"/>@@|| <lg><l>yid kyi mun pa ma lus sel byed pa ||</l> <l>rigs tshul dri med <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5292">shes rab sgron ma</rs> 'di ||</l>                       <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3773">dpal ldan grags pa</rs>'i gzhung dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:5590">bla ma</rs>'i<anchor xml:id="a469"/><!--assumed to be the same person whose views are referred to in the text on 5b1--> ||</l> <l>gsung la brten nas gzhan phan yid kyis sbyar ||</l> <l>'di las byung pa'i dge tshogs mthu' ldan des ||</l> <l>skye bo <abbr>thams cad</abbr> rigs lam 'dir zhugs te ||</l> <l>lta ngan g.yang sa'i ri bo rab bsnyil nas ||</l> <l>yang dag lta ba'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin par shog ||</l></lg> ||</seg></TEI>
